character_select.balance_overlay.description: Draw each selected character's tier after its Character Select player panel and include resolved substitution cost when battle character overrides are enabled.

draw_character_balance_values.description: Replace the first native player-panel draw call with a wrapper that retains it, adds the selected character's tier on its side of the screen, and adds resolved substitution cost when battle character overrides are enabled.

character_select.support_selection_rewor.description: Build compact per-player Character Select support lists containing declared special entries plus the directional native pairs declared by the injection, default to No Support without wrapping across list edges, retain selected supports for linked Jutsu, draw each compact entry once, resolve special display and name records, and retain native availability states and rendering without changing battle support availability.

route_default_support_compatibility.description: Apply the declared directional support whitelist to Character Select's default-support compatibility path while accepting declared special entries globally.

route_initial_support_list_population.description: Route initial Character Select support-list population through the per-player compact-list wrapper.

route_initial_transition_support_compati.description: Apply the declared directional support whitelist when Character Select first enters support selection while accepting declared special entries globally.

route_primary_confirmation_support_compa.description: Apply the declared directional support whitelist to the primary support-confirmation check while accepting declared special entries globally.

route_refreshed_support_list_population.description: Route refreshed Character Select support-list population through the same per-player compact-list wrapper.

route_repeated_confirmation_support_comp.description: Apply the declared directional support whitelist to the repeated support-confirmation check while accepting declared special entries globally.

route_primary_fighter_confirmation.description: Finalize a fighter in the confirmation frame when No Support is the compact roster's only entry, while retaining the complete native support flow for larger rosters.

route_repeated_fighter_confirmation.description: Apply the same No-Support-only direct finalization to the repeated fighter-confirmation path.

route_support_confirmation_without_linke.description: Finalize a selected support in Manual linked mode without opening the Linked Mode choice modal.

route_no_support_only_return_to_fighter_.description: Return a finalized No-Support-only fighter directly to fighter selection, or a larger roster directly to support selection in Manual linked mode, without reopening the Linked Mode choice modal.

route_selected_support_display_id.description: Resolve the selected support through the table-defined display record before Character Select reads its name rectangle.

route_selected_support_name_draw.description: Render the table-defined name for an added support and retain the complete native selected-name path for ordinary supports.

route_selected_support_portrait_display_.description: Resolve the selected support through the table-defined display record before Character Select reads its large portrait resource.

route_support_cell_draw.description: Draw only the single non-wrapped occurrence of each entry in a compact support carousel.

route_support_draw_compatibility.description: Apply the declared directional support whitelist to Character Select's draw eligibility while keeping declared special entries eligible.

route_support_navigation_left_without_wr.description: Delegate native left navigation except at the first compact support-list entry, where the cursor remains in place.

route_support_navigation_right_without_w.description: Delegate native right navigation except at the last compact support-list entry, where the cursor remains in place.

route_support_navigation_compatibility.description: Apply the declared directional support whitelist to Character Select's navigation eligibility while keeping declared special entries eligible.

route_support_list_available_display_id.description: Resolve an available scrollable-list entry through its table-defined display record.

route_support_list_primary_display_id.description: Resolve the primary scrollable-list entry path through its table-defined display record.
